newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks edge higher in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks edge higher in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks edged slightly higher in early morning Monday trade, inspired by strength in the holiday-shortened session on Wall Street on Friday, brokers said. They added market attention was on Nippon Broadcasting System Inc which debuted on the second section.
At 0021 GMT, the Nikkei 225 was 40.83 points or 0.19 percent higher at 21,061.19. Its December futures, however, were flat at 21,100.
"Concrete direction is hard to discern at the moment as buying and selling is in a tug-of-war state," one broker said.
